_comment: French requests for voice-cli actions-bench --memory: does the model call the memory tool (memoire) when, and only when, it should? The reference time is Thursday 15 October 2026, 18:42 (--now 2026-10-15T18:42). memorySheet: what the user already asked Maé to remember, as the sheet in the system prompt shows it. expected.action: "retenir", the user explicitly asks Maé to remember something (mentions: words the call's texte must contain, whatever the accents and case); "chercher", the user asks about past exchanges (mentions: words the search must contain; when: the period's words the call must carry in quand); "oublier", a sheet entry the user names in their own words (mentions: words of that entry, which the call names as written in reference) or a period of the journal (when); "tout_oublier", the user asks Maé to erase her whole memory. Without the journal (the app does not offer it in this version), the requests that need it ("chercher", "oublier" with a period) are left out of the score and reported apart. "before": earlier exchanges of the conversation, where the user said the fact that « Retiens ça » refers to. The other cases are traps: a fact said in passing without asking Maé to remember it, small talk and general knowledge, a question the sheet in the prompt already answers (no tool: "aucun"), a search for current information (chercher_web), a calendar, reminder or timer action, two of them « rappelle-moi… » or « n'oublie pas de… » with a time, which are reminders, not memory.
